policy_title: End Hostile Environment and Tackle Smuggling/Trafficking
stated: End the Conservatives’ Hostile Environment and invest instead in officers, training and technology to tackle smuggling, trafficking and modern slavery. Tackle modern slavery and human trafficking by: Reversing the Conservatives’ rollbacks of modern slavery protections. Transferring responsibility for identifying modern slavery victims from the Home Office to local safeguarding agencies.

source.quote: End the Conservatives’ Hostile Environment and invest instead in officers, training and technology to tackle smuggling, trafficking and modern slavery. Tackle modern slavery and human trafficking by: Reversing the Conservatives’ rollbacks of modern slavery protections. Transferring responsibility for identifying modern slavery victims from the Home Office to local safeguarding agencies.

bearing_set.reason: Investing in officers, training and technology to tackle smuggling, trafficking and modern slavery is directly a crime-prevention and justice measure, squarely within safety and security.

Ending the Hostile Environment directly affects equal treatment and anti-discrimination (including discriminatory effects on ethnic minorities and Windrush-era victims), while reversing modern slavery protection rollbacks and transferring victim-identification responsibility affects the legal-rights framework and due process protections for vulnerable people.

Modern slavery is labour exploitation at its extreme — strengthening victim identification and reversing protection rollbacks directly affects real wages (often zero for victims), job security, and in-work poverty for those in forced labour.

The Hostile Environment mandated private actors — landlords, banks, NHS, employers — to conduct immigration-status checks, constituting state-mandated surveillance/coercion; ending it removes that compulsory-check infrastructure and reduces state-imposed obligations on individuals and institutions.

membership_note: Three genuine bearings: the anti-trafficking investment is an O5 crime/justice measure; the modern-slavery protection and victim-identification reforms bear on O9 (due process, minority protections); and dismantling the Hostile Environment's network of mandated checks bears on O10 (freedom from state-imposed coercion and surveillance).
